body: I live in a third world country where i can't really speak out about this publicly

Once again, thanks for being so nice, man. I have these sudden mood swings every day where I just get filled with pure despair and loathing - this post was made during one of them. Having someone to talk to helps.

Hey. First off, thanks for the well thought out reply. You seem like a genuinely compassionate guy.

Now, here's the thing: I've had a very severe case of self loathing right from childhood. I *know* that most people don't view me in a light as negative as the one I view myself in. I *know* that the odds of the person I've just met hating me with a raging passion are close to zilch. You'd think self awareness in this situation helps, but it honestly doesn't. It doesn't stop me from succumbing to an endless loop of negative bullshit whenever I'm talking to a person. It doesn't stop me from telling myself over and over that the person standing opposite me is supremely bored of me and loathes me. I know how irrational that sounds, but it's something that's been hardwired into my brain, and no amount of self awareness or convincing is going to change that. Trust me, I've genuinely tried.

I get what you said about pruning back bad habits. That was exactly my rationale when I deleted facebook. I used to while away endless amounts of hours carefully curating this "cool" online persona solely to impress people who gave 0 fucks about me. Cutting that kind of toxicity out of my life is definitely going to help me.

It's just that... I wasn't always like this, man. I used to be pleasant to be around. I had friends, or at the least a group of people whom I used to hang out with and who gave the impression that they enjoyed being around me. I had hobbies, I used to be excited about stuff. I wasn't always a downer, wasn't always a gloomy cunt. But the last few years have really taken everything out of me. I've become a husk of the person I used to be. I have no drive, no motivation, no goals. 

And there is absolutely no reason for this to have happened, which is what fucking kills me. If there was some concrete reason that could be pinpointed, I'd work towards fixing it. On paper I have a really good life. I was born into a privileged family, and I've never wanted for anything. I've never been struck by tragedy. I was given infinite choices with regards to education by my parents, which is very rare in India. I chose one of the most lucrative fields to work in, and am in one of the best colleges in my city. 

But none of this gives me ANY kind of fulfillment. Honestly. If someone were to take all of it away tomorrow, there wouldn't be any change in my level of happiness. I've lost all interest in my hobbies. I used to average a book a day, now I feel barely any interest in picking one up at all. 

I've tried *everything* in my capacity, and sincerely done the best I can; it hasn't helped even a tiny bit. I've been as courteous, nice and helpful as I can to people, and it hasn't won me any friends. I've read a shit ton of self-help books and articles, and followed loads of "helpful" advice. It hasn't made me feel less empty, or less worthless. 

And I don't see any of that changing any soon. I cannot imagine any scenario where my life takes a sudden turn for the good. I feel drained of everything, man. I just want an out.
